fields.objection: Perfect plasticity has no matched Be hardening/ductility/fracture basis. First yield and numerical endpoints answer different questions.
fields.proposed_fix: Keep the strict no-yield criterion; measure the actual compression curve and fracture limits before crediting redistribution.

qualification: 047's regularizing in-plane core moduli remain unsourced, and its face-compression screen uses a tensile proxy. The 1.209–1.227 mm tolerance at SF1 is model-only.
